speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient presents with a 3-day history of pain in his left wrist, which worsened this morning accompanied by chills and malaise. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Disseminated gonococcal infection (DGI).

The combination of migratory polyarthralgia (knee pain), tenosynovitis/wrist pain, and systemic symptoms like fever/chills in a sexually active 17-year-old is highly characteristic of this condition. I will order a blood culture and Gram stain of the urethra immediately to confirm.
